Your installed Codex supports it with **GPT-6 Astra**. Launch:

```sh
codex -m gpt-6-astra -c 'service_tier="ultrafast"'
```

To make it the default, set these at the top level of your Codex `config.toml`:

```toml
model = "gpt-6-astra"
service_tier = "ultrafast"
```
